Normal (1 por turno, Nivel 1 a 4 sin sac: Normal Summon (1 per turn, Level 1 to 4 with no Tribute, 5 or 6 with 1 Tribute, 7 or more with 2), Special Summon (allowed by an effect, no limit on how many times) and the ones that use the Extra Deck: Fusion (you gather the specified materials), Synchro (a Tuner plus other monsters whose Levels add up to the Synchro's), Xyz (monsters of the same Level that stay underneath as materials), Link (you send monsters to the GY; they have no Level and their arrows show which zones they point to) and Pendulum (you Summon several monsters at once from your hand using two Scales). Robar (Draw), Inicio (Standby), Fase Pri: Draw Phase, Standby Phase, Main Phase 1, Battle Phase, Main Phase 2 and End Phase. In the Main Phases you play cards, Summon monsters and activate effects. Se arma la combinación de Continuas que: Set up a combination of Continuous cards that locks the opponent down, then win with a few attacks.
Se colocan 1 o 2 monstruos Péndulo en la: You place 1 or 2 Pendulum Monsters in the Pendulum Zones (the outermost Spell & Trap Zones). Each one has a Scale number. Once per turn, you can Pendulum Summon any number of monsters from your hand whose Level is between the two Scales (not including the Scales themselves).
Se empieza invocando un Kewl Tune, que u: You start by Summoning a Kewl Tune, which uses a Tuner from the hand to Synchro Summon the next one. Kewl Tune Cue (manipulates the opponent's draw) and Rotary (gives you information about their hand) provide control; Track Maker searches and works as a combo piece.
Se manda un Phantom Knight al Cementerio: Send a Phantom Knight to the Graveyard (GY), a Trap Summons it, and Xyz Summon.
Se mandan al Cementerio los materiales i: The specified materials are sent to the Graveyard (GY) (2 or more; if the card requires it, one of them must be a certain Type or have a certain name). The Link Rating is the number of arrows and the number of materials it requires. A Link can be material for another Link; one with Rating 2 or more can count as that many materials.
Se recomienda mirar el tablero y la mano: Check the opponent's board and hand before committing to a play.
Se superponen 2 o más monstruos del mism: 2 or more monsters of the same Level are overlaid (the number depends on each Xyz). Xyz Monsters have a Rank, not a Level. The materials stay "underneath" and are detached to pay for their effects.
Se usan las escalas Péndulo para invocar: Use the Pendulum Scales to Summon several Vaalmonica and climb to the Links.
Si te niegan el Ritual o no tenés los ma: If your Ritual gets negated or you don't have the materials, your hand is stuck with big monsters and no way out. The deck relies on a few key cards, so hand traps hurt.
Surge Blitzclique se muestra desde la ma: Surge Blitzclique is revealed from the hand to destroy a monster and Summon a Thunder monster from the hand; if a card is destroyed by an effect while Surge is on the field, it searches the Deck for another Blitzclique. Whisker Blitzclique (Level 8) Summons up to 3 Thunder monsters from the hand and can destroy cards on the field.
